invariants.rationale: The method always returns an Iterator<List<WriteStatus>>, so result should not be null on normal return.
partition is directly used both for computing bucketInfo and in error messages, so must not be null.
partitioner is cast and dereferenced, so it must not be null at any execution path reaching the return.
A return can only happen if the bucketType is INSERT or UPDATE, otherwise an exception is thrown before returning.
instantTime is likely required by downstream logic and is a required parameter.
